limits: This source/default-path check and successful build/sign/download boundary are evidence against a new installer command change, not proof that the CI failure is exclusively infrastructure.
manual_semantic_checks: Original exercise still calls export_client_generations with fixed product binaries and calls seal_generations without preview override.
Both binary versions are validated before sharing; payloads.get(version) accesses an already-populated A/B key on this path.
Default include_preview=False creates/exports only A/B and skips both new preview helpers; local evidence=None retains the old private evidence dictionary.
seal preview=None still constructs the original structural InputSnapshot at the same path.
Default stable sign_family paths/key filenames/arguments remain exactly the former stable constants.
Existing result gains data_only=False and source_provenance_verified=False; do not describe the entire helper/result schema as byte-identical.
New native M1 job is a separate isolated container/output, not a replacement for the 49-case workflow.
